name: Murray Mine Hill Fire Tower
summary: A user listing reports an apparent fire tower above the Murray Mine site in Greater Sudbury; no agency source confirms it, and the site is private.
status_note: Only a user-written listing says a structure that appears to be a firetower stands on the site.

access.note: The listing says the mine is on private property belonging to INCO, with no directions given. The Ontario record says part of the site is in an active mine complex and was not inspected.
